title: Agent War Begins: The Joy Metric Battleground
excerpt: The competitive landscape has shifted: AI is no longer a feature but the entire product experience, with joy becoming the ultimate differentiator. Testing and security teams now hold the keys to building the most joyous products in the agent war.
post_draft:
What if joy is the only metric that actually matters in AI?

The agent wars are here, and they're not won with features alone. They're won with user delight.

Testing and security teams are sitting on untapped power. While product teams race to build the next AI agent, you're the ones who can ensure it actually brings people joy—not frustration, confusion, or distrust.

The competitive edge isn't faster. It's happier.

In our latest piece, we explore how joy becomes your strategic weapon. How it shifts from a nice-to-have to the differentiator that wins markets. And why your role in quality and security is about to get a whole lot more strategic.

Read the full breakdown on what's changing in the agent landscape and how to position your team for what's next.
